raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer repeatedly executed search queries that provided redundant confirmation of the same information (e.g., that the Sasanian Empire succeeded the Parthian Empire) without introducing new authoritative sources or contextual nuance to strengthen the response. This pattern led to a cycle of repetitive searches without advancing the understanding of the original problem. WebSurfer failed to diversify or refine search methods and relied on snippets without extracting clear, authoritative citations explicitly addressing the predecessor relationship.
